suppressions.reason: Lynis does not detect the active Debian deb822 security sources on these hosts.
suppressions.evidence: Fresh 2026-10-11 host inspections confirmed the trixie-security suite in nginx /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources and coolify/runtime-control /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources; the finding checks only legacy sources.list formats.
suppressions.recheck_when: Revalidate if the Debian source format or Lynis package-source detection changes.

suppressions.reason: The host is managed with nftables, not legacy iptables rules.
suppressions.evidence: Fresh 2026-10-11 host inspections confirmed active inet filter input and forward chains with drop policies and rules on both hosts; nginx had 11/10 input/forward rules and Coolify's chains also contained explicit rules. The empty legacy iptables rule set is expected.
suppressions.recheck_when: Revalidate if the guest firewall backend or nftables policy changes.
